query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.role, u.custom_role_id, cr.name as custom_role_name
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN custom_roles cr ON u.custom_role_id = cr.id
WHERE u.role IN ('almoxarife', 'manutencao');
